format: HPID-Split identity representation and export audit

metric_scope.overlap_excess_root_fraction: Repeated mask ownership divided by supplied-root pixels.
metric_scope.unassigned_root_fraction: Supplied-root pixels not covered by any public prediction mask.
metric_scope.native_capabilities: A dash must be reported for baselines that do not emit a persistent identity package; absence is not scored as segmentation failure.
metric_scope.candidate_order_consistency: Exact reruns after fixed candidate-list permutations; this is an implementation-invariance audit, not stochastic model determinism.
metric_scope.export_payload_validation: The algorithm-authored manifest payload is validated separately from paco_evaluation.json, a post-inference evaluator sidecar added to every case directory and intentionally absent from that manifest.
